items.name: Structural Static Test
items.description: Static load test of airframe to ultimate load per FAR 23.305
items.result: All test points passed. Ultimate load sustained with no permanent deformation.

items.name: Crashworthiness Analysis
items.description: FAR 23.561 emergency landing dynamic FEA analysis

items.name: Fuel Tank Leak Test
items.description: Integral wing tank pressurised to 3.5 psi submerged, zero leakage in 10 min per FAR 23.965

items.name: Avionics Integration Test
items.description: End-to-end G1000 NXi integration test: PFD/MFD/ADAHRS/GPS/COM

items.name: ADS-B Compliance Test
items.description: ADS-B Out performance verification per 14 CFR 91.227, DO-260B
items.result: NIC dropped below 7 at low altitude due to GPS antenna masking. Re-test required.

items.name: VHF COM Range Test
items.description: Voice quality and range test: 100 NM at 5000 ft AGL per TSO-C169a

items.name: Brake Holding Test
items.description: Parking brake holding force verified at full static run-up (1800 RPM)

items.name: Electrical Load Analysis
items.description: Electrical load analysis showing bus voltage ≥ 26V under all flight conditions

items.name: Battery Endurance Test
items.description: Essential bus endurance test: 30 minutes at 15 A load from full charge

items.name: Emergency Power Transfer Test
items.description: Essential bus transfer < 10 ms during alternator failure; battery-only endurance ≥ 30 min

items.name: Cabin Temperature Profile
items.description: FEA cabin temperature distribution with OAT -18 °C, heat full on

items.name: CO Detector Validation
items.description: CO detector activation at 50 ±10 ppm, aural/visual alert verified

items.name: Flight Control Free-Play Check
items.description: All control surfaces: free play < 0.125 inch, full travel verified

items.name: Flutter Analysis
items.description: Flutter analysis per FAR 23.629: all surfaces mass-balanced, damping verified

items.name: Pitch Trim Range Test
items.description: Full trim wheel travel verified: ±30 lb stick force relief at all speeds

items.name: Fuel Flow Test
items.description: Fuel flow ≥ 14 GPH at max power, selector valve all positions

items.name: Nose Gear Shimmy Test
items.description: Nose gear damping verification: no sustained shimmy at 0-40 kn taxi speeds

items.name: Brake Energy Absorption
items.description: Kinetic energy capacity verification for rejected takeoff at MTOW 1157 kg

items.name: Engine Run-Up Test
items.description: Full-power engine run at 2700 RPM, magneto drop check, fuel flow verification
items.result: 2700 RPM achieved, mag drop 125 RPM (limit 150), fuel flow 15.4 GPH.

items.name: Fuel System Flow Test
items.description: Fuel flow test at all flight attitudes and power settings per FAR 23.955

items.name: Propeller Balance Test
items.description: Dynamic balance of propeller assembly to ≤0.2 IPS per SAE ARP 4162

items.name: Fuel Injection Calibration
items.description: Verify fuel flow balance within 0.5 GPH across all cylinders at 75 % power
items.result: Max imbalance 0.3 GPH across cylinders at 75 % power. Within 0.5 GPH limit.

items.name: Stall Warning Calibration
items.description: Stall warning horn activation verified 5-10 kn above stall in all configs
items.result: Horn activated at 55 KCAS (clean), 7 kn margin. All configs within spec.

items.name: ELT Functional Test
items.description: 406 MHz ELT activation test per TSO-C126b, G-switch threshold verified
